svg.text: Cumbreal / summit companion / model sheet v2.1 / 2026-10-15
Wide hips · short rounded feet · one smooth contour
Soft high dome on viewer left; lower right shelf.
White half-capsules; pupils look the same way.
A tiny warm smile directly below the eye gap.
Round nubs grow naturally from the contour.
Pack always visible; soft inverted-V foot gap.
No snowcap, outlines, gradients, texture or shadows.
03 SILHOUETTE TEST / nominal SVG pixel heights
04 CORE POSES / consistent anatomy and proportions
05 LEVELS / Cumbi gains gear as the student climbs
1. Preserve summit asymmetry and the soft right shoulder.
2. Use generous curves; keep eyes aligned and large.
3. Always include the ember backpack in full-body poses.
4. No ears, nose, whiskers, snowcap, outlines or 3D effects.
5. Keep the small smile close to the eyes. No gradients.
6. Check silhouette and foot cleft at 32px in real contexts.
7. Reduced motion: show the final pose without a jump.
8. No untested accessibility or production-readiness claims.
